---
title: "Сканирование параметров"
format: html
---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: true

# 1. Paketlerin Yüklenmesi ve Modül Dahil Edilmesi
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../..")))
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"

include(srcdir("SIRPetri.jl"))
using .SIRPetri
using DataFrames, CSV, Plots

# 2. Parametre Tarama Döngüsü (Диапазон β)
println("Запуск сканирования параметров...")
β_range = 0.1:0.05:0.8
γ_fixed = 0.1
tmax = 100.0
results = []

for β in β_range
    net, u0, _ = build_sir_network(β, γ_fixed)
    df = simulate_deterministic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), saveat = 0.5, rates = [β, γ_fixed])
    peak_I = maximum(df.I)
    final_R = df.R[end]
    push!(results, (β = β, peak_I = peak_I, final_R = final_R))
end

global df_scan = DataFrame(results)
CSV.write(datadir("sir_scan.csv"), df_scan)

# 3. График (Çizim ve Gösterim)
p = plot(
    df_scan.β,
    [df_scan.peak_I df_scan.final_R],
    label = ["Peak I" "Final R"],
    marker = :circle,
    xlabel = "β (infection rate)",
    ylabel = "Population",
)
savefig(plotsdir("sir_scan.png"))
display(p)

println("Сканирование β завершено. Результат в data/sir_scan.csv")
